title: What Happens If the Sun Vanishes Right Now? #Shorts
description:
If the Sun vanished right now, you would not notice for eight minutes and twenty seconds. Gravity travels at the speed of light, meaning Earth would continue orbiting empty space in broad daylight. But at the eight minute mark, sudden pitch black darkness would engulf the globe. Without solar gravity, Earth would violently slingshot into deep space at sixty-seven thousand miles per hour into absolute zero. Subscribe to SciBytes for daily mind-bending physics!
